exposure: Expression levels of miR-21-3p in maternal blood leukocytes
Expression levels of miR-155-5p in maternal blood leukocytes
cohort: The study included 50 preeclampsia patients and 50 healthy pregnant controls.
finding: Decreased expression levels of miR-21-3p and miR-155-5p in maternal blood leukocytes were significantly associated with preeclampsia.
